title: HELIX Govern: Schema Evolution Policy
description: Defines how HELIX Core resources, terminologies, and API specs change over time. Ensures backward compatibility and orderly transitions.

versioning.major: Breaking changes requiring migration. Removed required attributes, changed types, removed resources.
versioning.minor: Additive backward-compatible changes. New optional attributes, resources, terminology codes, endpoints.
versioning.patch: Documentation, descriptions, examples, governance artifacts only.

compatibility_rules: Required attributes can never be removed (can be made optional = minor)
Optional attributes can be added freely (minor)
Attribute types cannot change (add new attribute with new type, deprecate old)
Enum values can be added, never removed (deprecate instead)
Resource names cannot change (create new, deprecate old)
API endpoints follow the same rules
deprecation_process: 1. Mark deprecated: add 'deprecated: true' and 'deprecated_message' with version and replacement
2. Announce in release notes with migration guidance
3. Minimum 2 minor versions before removal (e.g., deprecated in 0.3, removable at 0.5)
4. Remove only in next major version with migration scripts

extensions.description: Institutions extend HELIX via a standardized 'extensions' object on any resource.
rules: Extensions are never validated by HELIX conformance checks
If 3+ institutions adopt the same extension, propose it as a core attribute
